item.title: Radicle, Fully Exposed: After the Noise Handshake, Everything Travels in the Clear
item.description: On Sept 23, Radicle disclosed that every released version ships unencrypted, unauthenticated node traffic. After the Noise XK handshake (32/32/48 bytes), data goes straight onto the raw socket. The official guidance: treat every private repository that crossed the wire as already public.
